draw_hint: Hold trigger or pinch and trace a closed outline on a surface.
move_hint: Hold grip to move within this surface.
delete_hint: Hold B / Y for two seconds to delete.
object_hint: Click thumbstick to open. Move left or right; trigger to confirm.
three_star: Optimal count and time; no collisions
sandbox_hint: Draw and launch freely. No win or loss.
v_welcome: Welcome to the Gravity Laboratory. Scan your surroundings to begin.
v_scan: Look around slowly to identify the floor, tables, and walls.
v_ready: Scan complete. Draw a portal on a detected surface.
v_draw: Hold the trigger or pinch, and trace a closed outline.
v_select: Click the thumbstick to choose a payload.
v_launch: Press the trigger to place the payload at the first portal.
v_loop: Loop established. The payload is circulating steadily.
v_fail: Collision detected. Experiment stopped. Reset the mission when ready.
v_move: Hold the grip button to move the portal within its current surface.
v_delete: Point at a portal and hold B or Y for two seconds to delete it.
v_lost: Surface tracking lost. Scan your surroundings again.
